component.name: Nekro Qantrip
component.summary: Insert parameterized prompts anywhere with a shortcut
用快捷键在任何应用中插入参数化的 Prompt

description.p: Press Ctrl+Shift+Q, type a few letters and insert a ready-made prompt into the app you are using. Templates are plain Markdown files with parameters; sync between devices is end-to-end encrypted.
按 Ctrl+Shift+Q，输入几个字母，就能把常用 Prompt 插入到当前应用。模板是带参数的 Markdown 文件，设备间同步为端到端加密。
